title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice R. T. Vachhani on 15.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 15/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 15.10.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 15/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 15.10.2026 ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice R. T. Vachhani would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Gita Gopi and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice L. S. Pirzada) would take up the matters
notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble
Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and Hon’ble Mr. Justice R.T.Vachhani.)
(3) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora would sit Single and take up
the matters at Sr. No. 98 to Sr. No. 148 notified before
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice M.R.Mengdey.)
By Order of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
